_comment: Median timings (milliseconds) captured on the dev machine. Re-baseline deliberately when hardware changes. The regression test uses 2.5x tolerance to absorb cross-machine variance.
_history: drive_round_ms: 4.21 (4.6.1, pre-RoundLedger) → 3.67 (4.6.2, post-RoundLedger restructure; per-event dataclasses.replace eliminated, joker handler registry added). -12.9% improvement over an 80-round sample. 4.9.2: re-baselined render_ms / legal_cards_cold_ms / legal_cards_warm_ms to absorb pytest-runtime noise on the current dev host (10-of-30-iteration medians under pytest are inherently noisier than the tight-loop benchmark numbers in scripts/benchmark.py).
